description: Configuration for Strava Activity Heatmap Generator

ACTIVITIES_DIR.description: Path to the directory containing your Strava export data (activities.csv and .fit.gz/.gpx files)
ACTIVITIES_DIR.title: Activities Dir

ACTIVITY_TYPES.description: List of activity types to include in the heatmap. Can use canonical types (Run, Ride, Swim, etc.) or common aliases (Running, Cycling, Bike, etc.)
ACTIVITY_TYPES.title: Activity Types

DATE_FROM.description: Start date for filtering activities (YYYY-MM-DD). Use null for no start limit.
DATE_FROM.title: Date From

DATE_TO.description: End date for filtering activities (YYYY-MM-DD). Use null for no end limit.
DATE_TO.title: Date To

HOME_LAT.description: Home latitude for radius filtering. Use null to disable radius filtering.
HOME_LAT.title: Home Lat

HOME_LON.description: Home longitude for radius filtering. Use null to disable radius filtering.
HOME_LON.title: Home Lon

RADIUS_KM.description: Radius in kilometers around home. Omit to infer a local radius from the export; use null explicitly to include all activities.
RADIUS_KM.title: Radius Km

GPS_SPREAD_MIN_M.description: Minimum GPS spread in meters. Activities with less spread are treated as stationary.
GPS_SPREAD_MIN_M.title: Gps Spread Min M

METERS_PER_PIXEL.description: Ground resolution in meters per pixel for the heatmap raster.
METERS_PER_PIXEL.title: Meters Per Pixel

PADDING_M.description: Padding in meters around the activity bounds for the heatmap extent.
PADDING_M.title: Padding M

TRACK_CLIP_RADIUS_KM.description: Optional maximum distance in km from home to clip tracks. Omit to disable clipping.
TRACK_CLIP_RADIUS_KM.title: Track Clip Radius Km

BLUR_SIGMA_PX.description: Gaussian blur sigma in pixels for smoothing the heatmap.
BLUR_SIGMA_PX.title: Blur Sigma Px

MAP_OPACITY.description: Opacity of the heatmap overlay (0.0 to 1.0).
MAP_OPACITY.title: Map Opacity

CARTO_STYLE.description: CARTO basemap tile style. One of: 'voyager', 'light_all', 'dark_all'.
CARTO_STYLE.title: Carto Style

SPEED_MIN_MS.description: Minimum speed in m/s to include GPS points. Use null for no minimum.
SPEED_MIN_MS.title: Speed Min Ms

SPEED_MAX_MS.description: Maximum speed in m/s to include GPS points. Use null for no maximum.
SPEED_MAX_MS.title: Speed Max Ms

HR_MIN_BPM.description: Minimum heart rate in BPM to include GPS points. Use null for no minimum.
HR_MIN_BPM.title: Hr Min Bpm

HR_MAX_BPM.description: Maximum heart rate in BPM to include GPS points. Use null for no maximum.
HR_MAX_BPM.title: Hr Max Bpm

AUTO_RANGE_PCT.description: Percentile for auto-ranging color scale (0-100). Lower values increase contrast.
AUTO_RANGE_PCT.title: Auto Range Pct

MAX_CONSECUTIVE_SAME_CELL.description: Maximum consecutive GPS points in the same raster cell before skipping.
MAX_CONSECUTIVE_SAME_CELL.title: Max Consecutive Same Cell

DECAY_FACTOR.description: Geometric decay (0.0-1.0) applied to repeated passes of the same cell within a single activity. Only used by the "decay" raster mode: 0.0 counts each cell once per activity (maximal spread); 1.0 counts every pass (inflates intensity for loops / out-and-backs).
DECAY_FACTOR.title: Decay Factor

RASTER_MODE.description: How each cell's pass count is computed for the "GPS Density (Time Spent)" layer. "raw-count" = every GPS point increments the cell; "decay" = exponential decay (DECAY_FACTOR) on repeated passes of the same cell within a single activity; "binary-per-activity" = each activity contributes max 1 per cell (pure coverage).
RASTER_MODE.title: Raster Mode

COVERAGE_NORMALIZATION.description: Normalization basis for the "Coverage (Places Visited)" layer: "pct" (default) = each cell shows the percentage of all activities that visited it; "max" = each cell is scaled relative to the most-visited cell (legacy).
COVERAGE_NORMALIZATION.title: Coverage Normalization

CACHE_DIR.description: Directory for cached data (relative to project root).
CACHE_DIR.title: Cache Dir

OUTPUT_DIR.description: Directory for output files (relative to project root).
OUTPUT_DIR.title: Output Dir

ACTIVITIES_CSV.description: Name of the activities CSV file in ACTIVITIES_DIR.
ACTIVITIES_CSV.title: Activities Csv

CACHE_FILE.description: Name of the cache file in CACHE_DIR.
CACHE_FILE.title: Cache File

OUTPUT_HTML.description: Name of the output HTML file in OUTPUT_DIR.
OUTPUT_HTML.title: Output Html

OUTPUT_GPX.description: Name of the GPX track export in OUTPUT_DIR. Every generate run rewrites it with the filtered activities (one GPX track each) so the same rides/runs can be opened in other tools.
OUTPUT_GPX.title: Output Gpx

EMBED_ENABLED.description: Also build a minimal, non-interactive HTML widget (no controls, fixed bounds) next to the full map, for embedding in an iframe. The --embed CLI flag turns this on for a single run.
EMBED_ENABLED.title: Embed Enabled

EMBED_HTML.description: Name of the embeddable widget file in OUTPUT_DIR.
EMBED_HTML.title: Embed Html

EMBED_LEGEND.description: Show the colour legend in the embeddable widget.
EMBED_LEGEND.title: Embed Legend

EMBED_ATTRIBUTION.description: Legacy setting retained for compatibility; tile attribution is always shown because the CARTO / OpenStreetMap tile terms require it.
EMBED_ATTRIBUTION.title: Embed Attribution

EMBED_HOME_MARKER.description: Show the home marker in the embeddable widget.
EMBED_HOME_MARKER.title: Embed Home Marker

EMBED_TRACKS.description: Draw the raw GPS tracks in the embeddable widget. Off by default, since the heatmap alone is usually the point of a small widget.
EMBED_TRACKS.title: Embed Tracks

EMBED_DEMO.description: Also write a small demo page beside the embeddable widget. It shows the widget in a responsive iframe (fluid width, fixed aspect ratio) with a copy-paste snippet, so opening it demonstrates how the widget embeds. Named after EMBED_HTML with a '_demo' suffix.
EMBED_DEMO.title: Embed Demo

EMBED_METRICS.description: Metric layers to bake into the embeddable widget and show there, since the widget has no toggles to switch them on. Entries are metric layer names or short aliases (pace, heart_rate, gradient, elev_change); the widget's density layer follows RASTER_MODE. Empty (the default) leaves the widget as the bare density heatmap.
EMBED_METRICS.title: Embed Metrics
